verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Nitrokey 3 supports FIDO2 and passwordless Microsoft login, but no item documents a FIDO2 PIN, a built-in biometric, or any other on-device user verification that would stop a stolen key from authenticating. The only related control is OpenPGP touch confirmation, which proves user presence rather than verification, so it is adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the key supports on-device user verification — a FIDO2 PIN or built-in biometric — so a stolen key alone cannot authenticate
